bundle.shortDescription: Gym journal & calorie tracker with on-device video analysis
bundle.longDescription: GymLab is an offline-first gym journal and calorie tracker. Log sets, reps and weight, analyze workout videos locally with on-device pose estimation, and estimate calories using ACSM Compendium 2024 MET values. Videos never leave your device.
